neighbours.label: The 'oph' word piece inside Greek-derived biological terms (-ophore, -ophyte, as in sporophyte, ionophore, onychophoran)
fire: Desert plants such as the xerophyte store water in thick leaves.
Squid change colour using chromatophores in their skin.
The Portuguese man o' war is a colonial siphonophore.
Fungal conidiophores bear chains of asexual spores.
In ferns the gametophyte is a small heart-shaped plant.
Researchers added a potassium ionophore to the membrane.
The flower's ovary sits on a short gynophore above the petals.
Mushroom sporophores appear after heavy autumn rain.
quiet: Desert plants such as the cactus store water in thick stems.
Octopuses change colour using pigment cells in their skin.
The Portuguese man o' war is a colonial animal related to jellyfish.
Fungal hyphae spread through the soil in thin threads.
In mosses the leafy plant produces eggs and sperm.
Researchers added a potassium channel to the membrane.
The flower's ovary sits on a short stalk above the petals.
Mushroom caps appear after heavy autumn rain.
